text: Infinite, fast, accessible feed · first posts painted fast, smooth scroll on cheap phones
originalText: Infinite, fast, accessible feed · first posts painted fast, smooth scroll on cheap phones

text:
Key decisions (RADIO)
- SSR the first page for a fast LCP,
  then hydrate and fetch by cursor
- Normalize posts and users by id:
  one like updates every copy
- Virtualize the list; keep focus and
  scroll position on new pages
- New posts show as a pill, never a jump
- Optimistic post with rollback on error
